name: Investigator Snake Whisperer
body:
Snake whisperers experiment extensively with snake poison, even developing toxic saliva akin to venom.

A snake whisperer has the following class features.

Serpent Sense (Ex)

At 3rd level, a snake whisperer can use speak with animals at will with reptilian animals (including various forms of dinosaurs, lizards, and other cold-blooded creatures), and he gains a viper familiar using his sorcerer level –2 as his effective wizard level.

This replaces the trap sense bonuses gained at 3rd, 9th, and 15th level.

Toxic Saliva (Ex)

At 4th level, using the swift alchemy ability, a snake whisperer can apply his toxic saliva to a weapon as a move action. The saliva remains toxic for 1 hour + 10 minutes for every two snake whisperer levels beyond fourth, or until the snake whisperer successfully strikes a creature. If a coated weapon leaves a snake whisperer’s possession, the toxic saliva becomes inert until the snake whisperer regains possession of the weapon. A snake whisperer can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1/2 his investigator level + his Intelligence bonus.

Toxic saliva- injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 snake whisperer level + Intelligence modifier; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1 Con damage and sickened for 1 minute; cure 1 save.

At 8th level, the poison damage increases to 1d2 Con, and it requires 2 saves to cure.

The poison damage increases to 1d3 Con at 12th level, and 1d4 Con at 16th level.

This replaces studied strike.

Spitting Mad (Ex)

At 20th level, a snake whisperer can use inspiration on all skill checkseven ones he isn’t trained in- and all ability checks without spending inspiration. In addition, a snake whisperer can expend 1 use of inspiration as a free action when applying toxic saliva to his weapon to add +1d6 to its save DC. Finally, once per day, a snake whisperer can create the effects of spit venom with a caster level equal to his investigator level.

This replaces true inspiration.
